model_interpretation.hypothesis: If per-character table lookups and serial bit assembly limit large valid inputs, decoding whole 32-character blocks with AVX2 range masks and arithmetic offsets, then vector bit packing, may improve throughput. retained: Classify each 32-byte input block with AVX2 range comparisons for uppercase, lowercase, digits, plus, and slash, then map sextets with arithmetic offsets and scalar-fallback on invalid blocks.
Pack the 32 sextets into 24 output bytes using AVX2 dword shifts, masks, and a byte shuffle; use an unaligned 32-byte load and exact-length memcpy stores.
Vectorize only a complete 32-character prefix after excluding terminal padding; decode any remaining characters, including padding and short tails, through the scalar decoder.
Keep AVX2 code in a GCC/Clang target("avx2") helper with runtime CPU feature dispatch; preserve scalar fallback and do not change build flags or add threads.
